thread:
Alex Chen: Heads up — premerge SAST is failing on feature/affinity-mesh after yesterday's RBAC change to the KMS role for scanner service account. merge is blocked by policy.
Maria Gonzalez: ugh, saw that. scanner svc lost kms:Decrypt for ephemeral keys? :confused:
Alex Chen: yes error in CI: `kms:AccessDenied` when scanner tries to decrypt signing key for evidence artifacts.
security-bot: [alert] automated-scan | job=premerge-sast | status=failed | link=https://ci.redwood/internal/job/9834 :rotating_light:
Jamal Patel: quick question — did the RBAC change remove the `scanner-keystore` binding or just scope it to a different project? I saw a role flip in the audit log but not details.
Oncall SRE: Checking audit now. give me a sec.
Oncall SRE: Query I ran: ```sql
SELECT timestamp, actor, action, resource
FROM kms_audit
WHERE resource LIKE '%scanner-keystore%'
ORDER BY timestamp DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Oncall SRE: shows a grant removal event at 2026-03-18T22:13:05 by infra@redwood.tools
Maria Gonzalez: that matches, infra patched RBAC to tighten cross-project scopes. We need a short-term approval to re-grant decrypt to `svc-scanner@infra`. Security lead okayed scoped read-only decrypt earlier, can we reapply minimal policy?
Jamal Patel: If we re-grant, we should pin it to the CI ephemeral key resource and add an audit-only condition: `request.time < now + 24h` so it auto-expires after we finish the rollout.
Alex Chen: can we do that without breaking compliance? need signoff from security for temporary exception.
security-bot: [policy] Exception request created by @Alex Chen: https://incidents.redwood/internal/exceptions/2487 — awaiting approval from Security Lead.
Maria Gonzalez: For unblock steps locally: run the scanner against the artifact with an explicit key override so you can reproduce: ```bash
export KMS_KEY=projects/redwood/locations/global/keyRings/ci/cryptoKeys/ev-artifact
scripts/run-sast --target=packages/affinity-mesh --auth=svc-scanner
```
Alex Chen: reproduced locally, same decrypt error. If infra can re-grant with expiry, I can re-run CI immediately and confirm.
Oncall SRE: I can apply a limited grant for 6 hours with the approval token. Need an explicit approval message in thread (audit trail). Maria, can you confirm approval text?
Maria Gonzalez: Confirmed: Security approves a scoped temporary decrypt grant for svc-scanner limited to the `ev-artifact` key for 6 hours to unblock premerge scans. Conditions: must be logged and automated expiration enforced.
Alex Chen: creating PR for emergency RBAC patch now, will include the exact IAM binding and the kms condition. PR: https://git.redwood/internal/iam/patches/993
Jamal Patel: Once PR merges, run: `ci/trigger-premerge-sast --job=9834 --force-retry` to requeue the job.
Alex Chen: done — PR merged and infra applied grant. Re-running CI.
security-bot: [alert] premerge-sast retriggered by @Alex Chen | job=9834
Oncall SRE: CI shows job running, tailing logs: `decrypt request accepted` :eyes:
Alex Chen: ✅ build passed. merging now. Thanks all — follow-up: we'll schedule a postmortem to remove emergency grant and update the keystore onboarding docs so scanner affinity nodes have a proper long-term policy.
Maria Gonzalez: I'll open the follow-up ticket and add remediation tasks: rotate the ephemeral key, add keystore test to the premerge smoke, and update docs.
Jamal Patel: also one action: add a CI check that verifies scanner principal still has decrypt access before running heavy scans (fast fail with clear error message).
Alex Chen: noted. assigning tasks in ticket 4021. :thumbsup:
Oncall SRE: closing the emergency exception now that CI passed. Logs and the approval message are preserved in exception 2487 for audit.
security-bot: [audit] exception-2487 | approved_by=Maria Gonzalez | closure=automatic
Maria Gonzalez: thanks everyone. short, messy, but done. :relieved:
